approval_required_for: Changing KV-cache scope from not_required to enabled, or introducing any KV-cache memory/runtime layout.
Changing attention architecture parameters after promotion, including num_q_heads, num_kv_heads, head_dim, seq_len, rope_theta, GQA grouping, or lanes.
Changing numeric policy, precision, tolerance, activation elem_bits, accumulator/input_bits, or decoder residual output_bits.

Replacing trusted templates, modifying template internals, changing data order, or adding free-form RTL for QKV projection, RoPE, GQA mapping, softmax, causal mask, output projection, FFN, norm, residual, or elementwise behavior.
Changing lanes, tile sizes, design-space choices, pipeline structure, memory layout, board memory assumptions, runtime address map, or board deployment assumptions.
Adding new required adapters, enabling unsupported operators, or making major template substitutions after Stage 2 promotion.
Selecting an app-shell/backend target when real board or Vivado evidence is missing, conflicting, or ambiguous.

executable_actions.on_failure: Block promotion, localize the failed operator/template/parameter/source/SACG edge, and issue a bounded same-stage repair or backtrack request; do not modify golden outputs, loosen tolerance, or alter template internals.
executable_actions.rationale: All supplied current-stage deterministic checker results pass, all Stage 2 current_stage_blocks are closed, and sacg_memory has no open retry, backtrack, or contamination barrier. This action seals the reviewed candidate without claiming downstream simulation or hardware success.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the artifact in template_selection, regenerate the handoff packet with missing SACG references or corrected blocker classification, and do not rely on downstream inference to recover Stage 2 evidence.
executable_actions.rationale: The next gate needs the ready contract, coverage decision, cross-layer trace, and stage-gate classification so later-stage gaps are not reclassified as Stage 2 blockers.

executable_actions.on_failure: Treat any attempted KV-cache enablement, hidden cache allocation, or attention semantic drift as an architecture or memory-layout change requiring explicit approval before downstream consumption.
executable_actions.rationale: Attention coverage is approved only with QKV projection, RoPE, GQA mapping, softmax, output projection, causal mask, and KV-cache not_required. Later memory/runtime planning must not silently enable cache state or change attention semantics.

executable_actions.on_failure: Stop code generation promotion, localize the mismatched template/source/hash/parameter edge, and route to bounded_template_repair with repair_boundary_check; do not replace trusted templates with free-form RTL or change numeric, memory, runtime, or board policy without approval.
executable_actions.rationale: Final generated accelerator code is a later-stage obligation. Code generation must preserve the Stage 2 trusted template IDs, source hashes, parameter values, numeric policy, data-order assumptions, and forbidden-edit boundaries.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not promote to multilayer or board verification. Localize the earliest causal boundary using tool output, CCTG/contract evidence, and targeted replay; repair within the bounded contract and rerun the failed layer before progressing.
executable_actions.rationale: Later numeric accuracy and simulation evidence are not Stage 2 blockers. After generated artifacts and verification contracts exist, verification must follow the three-layer loop: leaf/operator modules first, then the connected single-transformer-layer kernel, before any board-accurate AXI/DDR wrapped system.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep runtime bitstream and board runtime blocked; require bounded recovery or explicit approval for ambiguous targets and do not invent backend core, shell, or board names.
executable_actions.rationale: Backend/app-shell integration is downstream of Stage 2. Target names and shell integration points must be derived from supplied board materials plus real Vivado evidence; if evidence is ambiguous, the system must request bounded approval instead of guessing.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not create a false pass memory record; keep the promoted contract authoritative and rerun the SACG memory update before later-stage aggregation.
executable_actions.rationale: The shared design memory should preserve the ready outcome, absence of open Stage 2 retry/backtrack/contamination barriers, and the approved forbidden-edit boundaries for downstream agents.

proposed_actions: Promote the supplied candidate_template_selection as the Stage 2 template-selection contract and hand it to the cross-layer gate with the current checker evidence, source hashes, parameter bindings, and forbidden-edit boundaries preserved.

Record a SACG memory ready outcome stating that there are no open Stage 2 retry/backtrack/contamination barriers and that downstream agents must consume the promoted contract rather than stale or unsealed artifacts.
Carry the KV-cache not_required decision, attention submodule coverage, GQA grouping, numeric widths, lanes, tile sizes, source hashes, and no-free-form-RTL boundary into code generation.

In code generation, emit a manifest and generated accelerator package only from the trusted selected templates and bound parameters; block on any hash, template ID, parameter, data-order, or forbidden-edit mismatch.

After code generation, run hierarchical verification in order: operator/attention leaf checks, then connected single-transformer-layer checks, and only after those pass proceed toward board-accurate AXI/DDR wrapping.

Treat VCS/Verilator simulation, Vivado synthesis/implementation/timing/bitstream, runtime driver, board wrapper, DDR/AXI integration, numeric accuracy, and board bring-up as later-stage obligations, not Stage 2 risks.

At backend/app-shell integration time, run target discovery against real board materials and Vivado evidence; if target naming or shell integration evidence is ambiguous, require bounded approval rather than guessing.
